newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ENERGY AFRICA WINS IVORY COAST OIL PERMIT.
newsitem.headline: ENERGY AFRICA WINS IVORY COAST OIL PERMIT.

text.p: South Africa-based Energy Africa Ltd announced on Wednesday that it had acquired an exploration permit in Ivory Coast.
It said that a joint venture group it was part of had signed a production sharing agreement with the Ivory Coast government covering offshore oil field Block C1-102.
Ranger Oil Ltd will act as operator for the joint venture group which also includes Gulf Canada Resources subsidiary Clyde Expro Plc, Gentry Resources Ltd , TC Petroleum Inc and Petroci.
Energy Africa, Ranger Oil and Clyde hold the largest stakes in the joint venture of 24 percent each.
Block C1-102 lies immediately south of Abidjan in water depth generally lower than 200 metres and the block encompassess 793 square km, Energy Africa said.
The field lies between the Espoir field to the west and the Belier oil field to the east.

"This acquisition is the result of several months of looking at opportunities in Cote d'Ivoire and provides Energy Africa with access to a country with excellent exploration potential," said Energy Africa managing director John Bentley.
